notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three experience counters.
Lands you control are able to tap and produce at least {1}{R}{R}.
description:
Cast Turnabout by paying {U}{U}.
Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate for its buyback cost by paying {R}{R}, copying Turnabout and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Turnabout copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
